meaning:
under
Aramaic of ta.chat (תַּחַת ": under" H8478)

elsewhere.note: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’ ”
The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived…
